questions.prompt: What medium transmits power in a pneumatic system?
questions.explanation: Pneumatics uses compressed gas to perform work.

questions.prompt: Which component converts pneumatic power into mechanical motion?
questions.explanation: Cylinders create linear motion; air motors create rotary motion.

reviewCue.text: Find the passage below on the review slide. Focus on the component, condition, or relationship it describes.
reviewCue.excerpt: ► Actuators can either be cylinders, which produce linear motion. ► Actuators can also be motors, which produce rotary motion. 7

questions.prompt: What is the pressure regulator's main role?
questions.explanation: The regulator adjusts the pressure supplied to control and power circuits.

questions.prompt: What does an air filter remove from supply air?
questions.explanation: Ambient air contains contaminants; the filter cleans particles and water droplets from it.

reviewCue.text: Find the passage below on the review slide. Focus on the component, condition, or relationship it describes.

questions.prompt: Which pneumatic component does this symbol represent?
questions.explanation: The slide shows an adjustable spring, a pressure-sensing pilot line and the regulating flow path. These are features of the pressure-regulator symbol.
